executive_summary: All three think tanks converge on a single core finding: the repository has extensive infrastructure but ZERO domain output. Alpha says 'stop building, start executing.' Beta says 'add 2-3 MCP servers and start producing picks.' Gamma says 'fix data hygiene debt but it is not blocking execution.' The path forward is clear: execute market research using existing tools, fix critical bugs opportunistically, and resist the infrastructure recursion trap.

BUGS_TO_FIX.description: Bugs and data quality issues, prioritized by severity

items.finding: 15 orphaned scripts not in storage/scripts/index.json
items.details: Includes MCP KB server, smart_read/write/search, query_kb, semantic_indexer, semantic_search, validate_naming, auto_index, generate_registry, import_to_db, test-cross-references, benchmark_runner, dedup_utils, test_utilities. Several are actively referenced by SOP-035.
items.action: Add all 15 scripts to storage/scripts/index.json with proper metadata.

items.finding: TOCTOU-WS-001: complete_work race condition in work_stealing.py
items.details: Lines 294-318 in work_stealing.py. No BEGIN IMMEDIATE wraps SELECT+UPDATE. Another process can reclaim and reassign work between authorization check and completion UPDATE, causing result overwrites.
items.action: Wrap in BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction, add WHERE claimed_by=? AND status='claimed' to UPDATE, verify rowcount==1.

items.finding: TOCTOU-HP-001: fulfill_help crash inconsistency in help_protocol.py
items.details: Lines 573-613 in help_protocol.py. Two separate UPDATEs (help_requests + work_items) without BEGIN IMMEDIATE. Crash between them leaves inconsistent state.
items.action: Wrap both UPDATEs in BEGIN IMMEDIATE. Add WHERE status='accepted' AND accepted_by_team=? guard. Check rowcount.

items.finding: 34 of 41 KB entries missing 'title' field in YAML frontmatter
items.details: Titles exist only in knowledge-base/index.json, not in the source .md files. Index rebuilding from files would lose all titles. Tools reading entries directly cannot display titles.
items.action: Backfill title field into YAML frontmatter of all 34 entries from index.json. Scriptable.

items.finding: TEAM-0032 session not in teams/sessions/index.json
items.details: TEAM-0032.md exists on disk but is not indexed. session_count shows 30 but 31 files exist. TEAM-0032 documented MCP server creation, LanceDB integration, and 4 TOCTOU fixes.
items.action: Add TEAM-0032 entry to sessions/index.json, update session_count to 31.

items.finding: TOCTOU-DC-001: join_channel participant loss in direct_channels.py
items.details: Lines 370-389. Read-modify-write on JSON participants list without BEGIN IMMEDIATE. Concurrent joins silently drop participants.
items.action: Use BEGIN IMMEDIATE + json_insert() or json_set() in SQL. Or use compare-and-swap with expected version.

items.finding: TOCTOU-WS-002: pipeline stage double-start in work_stealing.py
items.details: Lines 570-592. Two agents can both start the same pipeline stage because status check and update are not atomic. Causes duplicate work.
items.action: Add WHERE status='ready' to UPDATE. Use BEGIN IMMEDIATE. Check rowcount==1.

items.finding: Duplicate FRED source (SRC-0018 + SRC-0039)
items.details: Both are FRED API entries with different data_types and slightly different URLs (trailing slash). SRC-0018 from TEAM-0010/0011, SRC-0039 from TEAM-0013.
items.action: Merge into single canonical entry, combine data_types, update by_data_type and by_access_type indexes.

items.finding: 11 Python scripts use kebab-case filenames violating SOP-029
items.details: build-cross-ref-index.py, repair-storage.py, search-storage.py, 5 stress-test-*.py files, test-cross-references.py, test-edge-cases.py, validate-storage.py. SOP-029 mandates snake_case.
items.action: Rename files to snake_case, update index.json filename references, update any import references.

items.finding: 3 SOP files with non-standard filenames
items.details: efficiency_guide.json (SOP-026), future_team_data_strategy.json (SOP-027), tool_sops.json (SOP-028) do not follow sop_NNN_name.json pattern.
items.action: Rename to follow sop_NNN_name.json convention. Update index references.

items.finding: TOCTOU-MTR-004: double stop() invocation in multi_team_runner.py
items.details: Lines 491-508. No guard against double invocation from signal handler + main thread. Can call _close_connection twice, send duplicate shutdown messages.
items.action: Add threading.Event or atomic flag. Check at entry: if not self._stopped.is_set(): self._stopped.set() else: return.

items.finding: 13 remaining medium/low TOCTOU bugs
items.details: 9 medium-severity (DC-003, HP-004, CH-001, CH-002, MTR-001, MTR-003, WS-004, WS-005, HP-006) and 5 low-severity (MTR-002, MTR-005, DDG-001, DDG-002, HP-005). Most are stale-snapshot issues or config read races.
items.action: Address in dedicated bug-fix session. Most are low-impact in practice.

agreements.topic: Infrastructure recursion is the primary blocker
agreements.alpha_position: CRITICAL blocker. 14+ team sessions of building infrastructure with zero domain output. 'Stop planning. Stop building frameworks. JUST DO THE RESEARCH.'
agreements.beta_position: Agrees. Anti-recommendations explicitly say 'Do NOT build sop_consolidator, trace_propagator, or zombie_reclaimer.' Ranks domain-enabling tools above infrastructure tools.
agreements.gamma_position: Agrees implicitly. Priority matrix ranks items by 'blocks_domain_work' flag. Infrastructure issues ranked lower.
agreements.consensus: UNANIMOUS. All three reports identify infrastructure recursion as the anti-pattern to break.

agreements.topic: FRED API source is duplicated (SRC-0018 + SRC-0039)
agreements.alpha_position: Lists both IDs in data sources inventory.
agreements.beta_position: Explicitly calls out duplicate. Recommends deduplication as part of FRED tool build.
agreements.gamma_position: Identified as Medium severity data quality issue. Provides specific fix approach.

agreements.topic: Existing tools are sufficient for first market picks
agreements.alpha_position: WebSearch/WebFetch plus existing methods guides are enough. 'The primary blocker is not tooling.'
agreements.beta_position: Agrees but recommends adding MCP servers for better data access. 'The biggest gap is not in tools or infrastructure.'
agreements.gamma_position: Confirms sources index is functional (correcting KB-0031 claim of catastrophic breakage).
agreements.consensus: UNANIMOUS. First picks can be produced now. Additional tools enhance but do not enable.

agreements.alpha_position: Calls sources index issues 'cosmetic' and LOW severity.
agreements.beta_position: Uses source catalog data without flagging quality issues.
agreements.gamma_position: Explicitly corrects KB-0031: 'All 41 entries match their corresponding SRC-*.json files. The index was likely rebuilt since KB-0031.'
agreements.consensus: UNANIMOUS. Sources index is functional. KB-0031's 'catastrophically broken' assessment is outdated.

disagreements.topic: Whether to build custom data-gathering scripts vs adopt MCP servers
disagreements.alpha_position: Says 'No scripts needed -- this is analytical work.' Recommends WebSearch/WebFetch as primary data mechanism. Notes 'No financial-data-specific scripts exist' as LOW severity blocker.
disagreements.beta_position: Recommends building method_sec_edgar.py, method_fred.py, method_finnhub.py AND adopting MCP servers. Explicitly says 'Do NOT build custom financial data scripts when MCP servers exist' for Alpha Vantage/Yahoo/FMP, but BUILD for SEC EDGAR and FRED where no MCP servers exist.
disagreements.resolution: Beta's nuanced position is more actionable: ADOPT MCP servers where they exist (Alpha Vantage, Yahoo Finance), BUILD only where no MCP server exists (SEC EDGAR, FRED). Alpha's position of 'just use WebSearch' is a valid immediate-action approach but not sustainable for repeated research.

disagreements.topic: Alpha Vantage free tier rate limits
disagreements.alpha_position: States '5 API calls/minute on free tier, 500/day'
disagreements.beta_position: States '25 calls/day (free tier, reduced from 500 in late 2024)'
disagreements.resolution: Beta's data appears more current (explicitly notes the 2024 reduction). The free tier was significantly reduced, making MCP servers and alternative APIs more important.

disagreements.alpha_position: Does not mention TOCTOU bugs. Implies coordination system is working well enough.
disagreements.beta_position: Does not mention TOCTOU bugs directly. Anti-recommends building more coordination tools.
disagreements.gamma_position: Identifies 18 remaining TOCTOU bugs, 2 critical. Says critical ones 'block domain work.'
disagreements.resolution: Gamma's position deserves attention for the 2 critical bugs (WS-001, HP-001) which can cause silent data loss in multi-agent coordination. However, for single-agent market research execution (Alpha's plan), these bugs are not blocking.
